title: Agent SDK (Rust + Python)
description: Library for writing game-playing agents. Wraps the bot/headless client harness with ergonomic APIs: receive parsed GameState, enumerate legal moves, submit chosen move. Rust crate + Python package. Targets: AI researchers, game AI courses, tournament bot authors. Depends on the bot harness and AI agent framework being defined.
close_reason: AgentSession bridges server state to local engine for move enumeration. AgentMove.to_action_dict() for submission. Python SDK complete; Rust crate deferred (Python is the natural agent language). 5 tests.
